title: Oozing Japanese Pork Skillet
description: A sour, gooey, brunch‑mood dish inspired by Chugoku cuisine, featuring seared pork chops in a bhuna‑style sauce that is FODMAP‑friendly.
instructions: Pat and season pork chops with salt, pepper, turmeric, and cumin.
Heat sesame oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Sear pork chops until browned, about 3 minutes per side, then flip.
Reduce heat to medium, add ginger, soy sauce, rice vinegar, mirin, maple syrup, and vegetable broth, then cover.
Cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pork is cooked through and sauce thickens.
Remove lid, increase heat to high, and simmer until sauce reduces to a glossy, oozing consistency, about 3 minutes.
Stir in scallion greens and cilantro, toss pork to coat with sauce, and finish.
Serve hot, optionally with steamed rice or low‑FODMAP noodles.
